data: NVIDIA reported revenue of $130,497 million (about $130.5 billion) for fiscal 2025, which ended January 26, 2025, up from $60,922 million in fiscal 2024. That is growth of roughly 114%, or about $69.6 billion. Net income was $72,880 million (about $72.9 billion), compared with $29,760 million in fiscal 2024, an increase of about 145%. Diluted earnings per share rose to $2.94 from $1.19.
